evidence.reason: The drain loop checks `result["drained"]` and breaks before checking the deadline, while the only sleep uses the full `drain_interval_s`. With `--drain-deadline-s 10 --drain-interval-s 600`, an initially blocked queue can be polled again after 600 seconds, report drained, and be accepted even though the deadline expired at 10 seconds. There is no post-loop deadline validation. The smallest compatible fix is to cap each sleep to the remaining time and reject a drained result observed after expiry, while still accepting an immediate first-poll drained result.
